fieldData.description:
To celebrate 1 year anniversary of Radix mainnet launch, come share drink & food with your fellow Malaysian community members and chat about crypto, DeFi, and of course RadixDLT! This event will be very casual and welcoming. Anyone who wants to make friends and learn about DeFi is welcome. Free food, drinks for everyone.
Feel free to reach out to @Rain2418 on Telegram for any clarification and join Malaysia community https://t.me/radix_sg_msia
fieldData.location: Secret Of Louisiana at the lake 1 Jalan SS 7/13a #D - 01 Petaling Jaya, Selangor 47301 Malaysia
fieldData.name: Radix Community Meetup - Malaysia
